{"metadata":{"description":"在 DeepSeek Harness 里驱动 iOS 模拟器：21 个原生 ios_* 工具覆盖工程发现、构建、安装、启动、截图与日志，并提供设置页 | Drives the iOS Simulator from DeepSeek Harness: 21 native ios_* tools for Xcode project discovery, build, install, launch, screenshots and logs, plus a settings page.","id":"gh:1422373025","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-ios-simulator-helper","slug":"zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","idb","ios","ios-simulator","macos","simctl","simulator","xcode","xcodebuild"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"在 DeepSeek Harness 里驱动 iOS 模拟器：21 个原生 ios_* 工具覆盖工程发现、构建、安装、启动、截图与日志，并提供设置页 | Drives the iOS Simulato"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"r from DeepSeek Harness: 21 native ios_* tools for Xcode project discovery, build, install, launch, "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"screenshots and logs, plus a settings page."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-ios-simulator-helper"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) native port of the official ZCode `ios-simulator@0.1.0` plugin: all 20 orig"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"inal MCP tools preserved as native DSH tools, plus a **parameter page on the plugin's own detail pag"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"e** in the Plugins panel (Plugins → Installed plugins → iOS Simulator Helper) that edits the simulat"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"or parameters in-app instead of through environment variables."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- Tool and argument names are identical to the original, so workflows written for the `ios_simulator"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"` MCP server keep working; one tool is added — `ios_shutdown_simulator`, because the original could "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"boot a simulator but never stop one.
- 17 settings fields in 5 groups, all live-editable; an empty f"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ield falls back to the original plugin's `IOS_SIM_*` variable, then to the built-in default.
- The p"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"arameter page detects the host system and, **on a non-macOS host, states that this plugin only suppo"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"rts macOS**; every tool that drives Apple tooling then refuses with a clear message instead of faili"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"ng with `spawn xcrun ENOENT`, while `ios_preflight` reports the failing host check and `ios_discover"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"_project`, `ios_create_app` and `ios_ui_status` still answer.
- Published as `@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simul"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"ator-helper`; the plugin page shows **iOS Simulator Helper** / **iOS 模拟器助手** from `locale/` rather t"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"han the raw package name, and both descriptions say the plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with"},{"id":"p5s11","text":" raw package name, and both descriptions say the plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with Apple."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"On a Mac with full Xcode, at least one iOS runtime and DSH installed:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"1. **Install the plugin**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"In DSH Desktop, open **Plugins** and add the same package name there. Without it, build/run/screenshot/logs are unaffected. |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`ios_preflight` checks every item above and prints a fix for each failure; the parameter page's "Run"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" diagnostic" button runs the same checks."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**DSH Desktop**: the `desktop` profile belongs to the Electron app — open **Plugins**, add `@zhz8888"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"/dsh-ios-simulator-helper` there, and enable the row it creates. After a reload or restart the form "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"is at **Plugins → Installed plugins → iOS Simulator Helper**; it only appears while the host half ac"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"tually serves this plugin's settings namespace."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Upgrade and uninstall"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Version gate"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Configuration page"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **macOS only.** On any other host `ios_preflight` fails the `Host OS (macOS)` check and skips the "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"remaining probes instead of producing meaningless spawn failures; every tool that drives Apple tooli"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ng refuses, `ios_discover_project`, `ios_create_app` and `ios_ui_status` still answer, and the confi"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"guration page keeps the notice at the top.
- `ios_ui_*` needs `idb`; `ios_ui_status` explains what i"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"s missing. `xcodebuildmcp` is only a reserved value (matching the original's `reservedBackends`) and"},{"id":"p31s6","text":" is not implemented.
- The original's `ios_build_and_run` always opened the Simulator window; here t"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"hat is the `autoOpenSimulator` setting (on by default, so behaviour matches). `ios_build_app` and `i"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"os_screenshot` still do not open windows, as in the original. The window app is Simulator.app on Xco"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"de 25 and earlier and Device Hub on Xcode 26 and later; a window that cannot be opened is reported i"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"n the result (`opened: false` plus `openWarning`) and never fails the `simctl` steps.
- `ios_logs` r"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"eads `log show` (no live stream), with a configurable and clamped window and length.
- Swift macros "},{"id":"p31s12","text":"(`@State`, `#Preview`) need `swift-plugin-server`, which cannot start its nested `sandbox-exec` when"},{"id":"p31s13","text":" the caller is itself sandboxed. `ios_build_app` then retries the build once with `OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS"},{"id":"p31s14","text":"=-disable-sandbox` and reports `macroSandboxRetry: true`; a caller that was never sandboxed never se"},{"id":"p31s15","text":"es a retry.
- The generated project template is byte-for-byte the original's (an Xcode 14-compatible"},{"id":"p31s16","text":" `project.pbxproj`, `objectVersion = 56`) and does not track newer Xcode templates.
- **The configur"},{"id":"p31s17","text":"ation page has only been checked by eye in DSH Desktop**: the plugin is installed into the `desktop`"},{"id":"p31s18","text":" profile, and the four shots in `assets/` are the latest manual pass, top to bottom. Dark theme, nar"},{"id":"p31s19","text":"row-width wrapping and the non-macOS notice are still covered by the render tests, not by eye.
- No "},{"id":"p31s20","text":"credential handling: the plugin never reads or forwards key/token/secret environment variables."}],"truncated":true}
